{{Top|leg}}
A '''seismologist''' was a type of [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] that specialized in the study of seismic activity, such as earthquakes and tectonic movement. [[Hare'en]] was a seismologist employed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to work on the [[Shock Drum]] project.
